Tool: built-in imagegen, transparent_background=true.
Final export: 1024x1024 RGBA PNG.

Restyle the targeting crosshair in the attached reference for our dark cosmic purple 2D military strategy game UI. Reference shows two copies of essentially the SAME reticle on a grey screenshot background. Output ONLY ONE reticle, centered on a square 1024x1024 transparent PNG canvas, about 85% canvas width and height. Do NOT reproduce the screenshot or duplicate the reticle.
Preserve the reference reticle geometry: compact small concentric polygonal central aiming ring with an OPEN transparent center, a larger thin broken circular/squarish targeting outline, short horizontal side ticks and small lower dash, four chunky diagonal outward arrow/triangle markers at the four diagonal corners. Preserve relative proportions, gaps, visual structure and orientation from reference. Make contours clean and crisp with a subtle hand-painted game UI finish, readable at tiny in-game cursor size.
Theme: deep night violet #1A0B2E to #2B1150 on the narrow solid reticle parts, charcoal gunmetal thin outlines, restrained luminous violet-magenta edge accents #C04DFF to #FF3DDB. A faint nebula texture only on the solid larger arrow markers, a few tiny specks if space permits, no busy texture. Thin sharp bright central aiming ring, subdued outer markers. Minimal soft violet halo close to edges, no broad bloom obscuring target.
Crucial: this is a FUNCTIONAL aiming reticle, NOT a solid disc icon. ALL empty spaces between the lines and markers, the entire region inside the outer outline except the central aiming ring and dash, and the small center hole MUST be actual alpha=0 so the player can see the battlefield. Remove original black fill as well as grey background. No filled circular background. No nebula backdrop across the open targeting area.
No text, no extra icons or decorations, no extra rings, no weapon illustration, no floor or ground shadow, no checkerboard. Genuine PNG alpha transparency outside and throughout all open holes. One isolated game crosshair sprite.
